events.title: Meteor crosses the system

participants.note: fast mover, not a field member

events.arrangement: One large rock crosses the whole pocket on a straight line at 3-4x traffic speed, entering and exiting at the speed-revealed band
events.startConditions: Environmental spawn roll (rare enough to stay an event: 1-2 per hour class)
events.visibleCue: A contact moving too fast on too straight a line with NO drive glow - mass without intent reads instantly as nature

phases.name: inbound
phases.visible: The rock crests the pocket edge trailing a thin dust line

phases.name: passage
phases.visible: Crosses the lane band; every hull's passive avoidance bulges in sequence as it passes - a wave through traffic, nature parting the sea

phases.name: gone
phases.visible: Exits; the dust line hangs a moment longer than the rock

events.completion: Nothing changed - and everyone briefly shared the same sky. That is the event

interruptions.outcome: Fragment spray on the original vector; ore pickups for the quick

playerInterference: Crack it for the ore spray
Just watch it go - with everyone else
events.criminalOpportunity: Every eye in the pocket tracks the rock for fifteen seconds - the region's best natural distraction
events.fallback: None needed - a rock cannot despawn wrongly; it only leaves

events.title: Anomaly forces a traffic diversion
events.arrangement: Anomaly manifests near the lane; traffic bends away; ONE hull - the surveyor - flies toward what everything else flees
events.startConditions: Existing anomaly_whisper encounter fires within 100 wu of a lane
events.visibleCue: The lane bending away from a point with nothing visibly there - absence with authority; then one small hull turning IN

phases.name: manifest
phases.visible: Whisper phenomenon plays (existing encounter VFX); nearest hulls side-step first, the bend propagating up-lane

phases.name: divert
phases.visible: Traffic runs the bent line; patrol cones the near edge if present (composes with ev_lane_spot_closure)

phases.name: approach_of_one
phases.visible: The surveyor closes to reading range and holds, pin crabbed, green rings slow and deliberate - courage as choreography

phases.name: fade
phases.visible: Phenomenon subsides; the surveyor drops one marker at the site; traffic straightens over a minute

events.completion: Lane restored; one lit marker where it happened - the map gains a haunted spot

interruptions.outcome: Unread anomaly; marker never placed; the whisper's mystery survives intact

playerInterference: Fly into the anomaly yourself (existing whisper interaction)
Follow the surveyor in - the only hull that knows what it is doing
events.criminalOpportunity: The bent lane is a scheduled choke while it lasts; and whatever the surveyor learned is worth shadowing
events.aftermath: Marker persists; the site's slot records the visit (later whisper events weight toward marked sites - the world builds its own mythology)
events.fallback: Surveyor unavailable: the diversion runs without the approach-of-one - nature unexamined

events.title: Gravity eddy captures a wreck fragment
events.arrangement: A fragment drifts into the eddy and settles into a visible slow orbit around empty space - a one-piece ring system
events.startConditions: Eddy field active near a wreck field
events.visibleCue: Debris ORBITING nothing - motion that violates the pocket's flat physics announces the exception

phases.name: capture
phases.visible: Fragment's line bends into a closing spiral

phases.name: ring
phases.visible: Stable slow orbit; dust tail spreads along the path

phases.name: visit
phases.visible: A salvor arrives, matches the orbit - the strangest station-keeping job in the belt - and cuts the fragment free

events.completion: Fragment recovered or orbit decays; the eddy stays, invisibly waiting

interruptions.outcome: Your own line bends - the field teaches itself

playerInterference: Throw cargo INTO the eddy and watch it ring (physics as a toy)
events.criminalOpportunity: An eddy is a natural cache: things thrown in stay findable - the dead-drop that nature runs
events.aftermath: Eddy site persists as a known hazard/utility
events.fallback: Salvor never comes: the orbit decays over the session
events.blockedOn: future.gravityField - no local gravity/force-field affects entity motion; the flat drift model cannot orbit

events.title: Static squall closes the worksite
events.arrangement: A charged dust bank rolls across the field; work stops ahead of it; hulls shelter leeward of the biggest rocks
events.startConditions: Environmental scheduler; squall vector crosses an active field
events.visibleCue: Miners stowing gear while the sky is still clear - the workers always know before you do

phases.name: warning
phases.visible: Deploy scalars reverse across the pocket (arms fold, umbrellas close); hulls reposition leeward

phases.name: squall
phases.visible: Dust bank crosses; lamps arc and flicker inside it; every hull dark and still in rock shadow

phases.name: all_clear
phases.visible: Cones relight one by one as the bank clears - the pocket rebooting trade by trade

events.completion: Work resumes; the squall exits the pocket edge

interruptions.trigger: A hull caught in the open
interruptions.outcome: Takes visible arc damage, may chain into the disabled/distress events

playerInterference: Shelter with the miners (they made room for you at the rock)
Fly the squall for bravado (damage ticks)
events.criminalOpportunity: The squall is a scheduled blackout: everything unattended, everyone blind, for ninety seconds
events.aftermath: None; the ritual is the content
events.fallback: No shelter rocks in the pocket: hulls run for the edge instead - a visible evacuation rather than a shelter
events.blockedOn: future environmental volume (shares the field-volume mechanic with gravity): no damaging/occluding weather volume exists; the stow-and-shelter choreography is ready the day one does

events.title: Asteroid calves under its own stress
events.arrangement: A big rock splits into two bodies plus a fragment spray; the halves drift apart at reading speed
events.startConditions: Heavily-worked rock passes a stress threshold (mining events accelerate it - consequence chaining), or natural roll
events.visibleCue: A dust jet from a rock nobody is cutting - the rock announcing its own event

phases.name: groan
phases.visible: Dust jets from a spreading seam line across the face

phases.name: calve
phases.visible: The rock separates; two bodies, one bright fresh face each, fragment spray between

phases.name: drift
phases.visible: Halves part slowly; any working miner backs off during calve then re-approaches the RICHER face - the professionals judge instantly

events.completion: The field permanently gains a body; fresh faces are visibly brighter ore

interruptions.trigger: Player inside the seam line at calve
interruptions.outcome: Fragment damage; your own fault, and legible in advance

playerInterference: Mine the fresh face (yield bonus window)
events.criminalOpportunity: Fresh faces draw every miner in range within minutes - a predictable gathering of loaded targets follows each calving
events.aftermath: PERSISTENT: the field's body count changes; fresh-face yield flag for the session; the pocket map is different now
events.fallback: No miner present: the calving happens for nobody - and a player who stumbles on the doubled rock later reads the fresh faces anyway
events.notes: Split = swap one asteroid entity for two smaller + pickup spray; the visualFactory's seeded rock variants already make the halves look related. PQ-045.causal-chain + INFERENCE U1: LIVE on Ceres as link 7 (environmental coda closing every cycle); actor ceres_seam_miner (catalog-optional participant, reaffirm-only); requires rich_seam (planted on every strike outcome); seeds rock_calved at calve (same seed on interrupt - the calving happens for nobody); phases groan/calve/drift at catalog durations on the authored-signal subset blind_cone/breaking_the_pattern/stacking (the rock-side visuals - dust jet, split, parting halves - render only via the miner's hull signals until the body-split seam exists). Persistent body-split + fresh-face yield flag stay UNWIRED until a runtime asteroid-body swap seam exists.

events.title: Fast debris stream rakes the corridor
environment: 8-10 small fast debris objects on parallel vectors
events.arrangement: A ribbon of fast small debris crosses the corridor diagonally over a minute - the accident event's dangerous cousin (fast and linear where that one is slow and cloudy)
events.startConditions: Environmental scheduler; upstream battle or calving seeds the stream vector
events.visibleCue: The first strike: one lane pin sparks and tumbles - furniture takes the hit before anyone else, and everyone sees it

phases.name: first_strike
phases.visible: A pin or marker takes a visible hit; its strobe dies mid-blink

phases.name: rake
phases.visible: The ribbon crosses; traffic holds at BOTH edges in visible clumps rather than threading - fast debris changes the etiquette from thread to wait

phases.name: pass_and_count
phases.visible: Stream exits; traffic re-flows; the sweeper starts on the strike damage; the dead pin stays dark

events.completion: Corridor restored, minus one lamp - the region keeps a scar

interruptions.outcome: Visible strikes; chains into the disabled/distress family

playerInterference: Thread the stream (skill expression; the etiquette exists to be defied)
Guard the waiting clumps - they are toll-vulnerable
Repair or salvage the dead pin
events.criminalOpportunity: The waiting clumps at either edge are pre-gathered, stationary and impatient - a toll or ambush wired by weather
events.aftermath: Dead furniture persists (repairable by later tender events); strike scars on struck hulls
events.fallback: No furniture in the pocket: first_strike falls on a rock instead - less legible, still legible
